units.title: Core contracts, extension points, errors
units.exit_gate: Record kinds, relation types, error codes, and missing-engine results exist and are covered by tests.

units.title: Evidence store, query, provenance, content binding
units.exit_gate: SQLite plus content-addressed blobs store the ten record kinds and the eight relations; raw rows are immutable.

units.title: Dependency audit, cache, freshness
units.exit_gate: Cache keys bind content, deps, tool, params, config, and environment. A clean import scan is not a closure proof. Content changes stale derived observations.

units.title: Retraction, concurrency, recovery
units.exit_gate: Retraction recomputes support and does not delete rows. Concurrent decision reads do not observe a torn pass. A crash before commit leaves no row.

units.title: Native static-analysis adapter
units.exit_gate: Headless Ghidra, not a fake adapter, analyzes one ELF and the export is kept.

units.title: Sandboxed execution, timeout, cancel, resources
units.exit_gate: Timeout, truncation, nonzero exit, secret stripping, and a file-size limit are explicit non-passes, and the dev ELF was run under that runner.

units.title: Behavior contracts and compatibility judgment
units.exit_gate: Compare the observation surfaces required by a frozen target contract, without treating an uncollected surface as a match.
limitations: verdict covers the collected surfaces of the sealed inputs only
compression_level_9 stays not_compared in the contract verdict

units.title: Hypotheses, experiment choice, active analysis
units.exit_gate: Choose a distinguishing experiment from disagreements and cost, run it, and keep the raw result.
limitations: one hypothesis pair on tune-alpha; level -9 differed from the default

units.title: Counterexample search and failure shrinking
units.exit_gate: Shrink a failing case without changing the failure predicate, and do not claim a global minimum.
limitations: reduced length 4 under deletion search; global_minimum is false

units.title: Attribution experiments
units.exit_gate: Run the required attribution samples on a measured value function, including retraction, confounding, noise, and missing coalitions.
units.checkpoint: Measured v on dev checks. Round-trip without compress is null, not zero. Shapley is uncertain because those coalitions are missing. Synthetic validation samples are marked measured_on_zlib false.

units.title: Runnable compatible project
units.exit_gate: A compatible zlib baseline builds, installs, and passes the sealed must-keep behaviors.
limitations: this is the upstream sources, not a new codec
units.checkpoint: Official zlib 1.4 build installed as prefix/bin/minigzip. Sealed surfaces matched, including 8/8 final inputs. Non-blind. compression_level_9 stayed not_compared.

units.title: Improvement candidate

units.checkpoint: Goal frozen before the LTO candidate. Candidate decompress median was 99.6% of baseline, not the required 90%. Delivery: compatible baseline done, enhancement not met.
